title: Penthouse Magazine June 2006 Sully Erna Godsmack J.J. Abrams Louis C.K. Sounds
conditionDescription: Covers clean with no visible creases or tears; spine intact. Original $8.99 price sticker on front cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, June 2006 issue.

Cover features: "Two or Three Women a Night!" Godsmack's Sully Erna confesses; J.J. Abrams on Mission: Impossible III; exclusive first look at the Da Vinci Code game; "Is HBO Ready for Louis C.K.?"; Video-Game Workout; The Sounds' Maja Ivarsson.

Back cover: Djarum Black clove cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
